fusions.name: Tangled Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 5 strands in a fan, each dealing 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Reeled Strand
fusions.desc: Strikes only a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up: deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Screen
fusions.desc: Weaves a screen of strands 5 tiles long that nothing crosses for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Combed Links
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of woven strands: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your dodge chance rises by 3%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
